page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.r9i.large is a memory-optimized cloud server instance built on the x86_64 instruction set architecture under the KVM hypervisor. Hardware provisioning includes two dedicated Intel Xeon 6982P-C virtual CPUs clocked at a base frequency of 3.2 GHz and 16.0 GB of system memory, establishing a 1:8 vCPU-to-memory distribution of 8.0 GB RAM per virtual core.

The instance features a baseline network bandwidth of 2 Gbps. It does not provision bundled local NVMe or SSD storage disks, which necessitates reliance on attached network storage for all file system persistence and data durability. In addition, the instance contains no GPU acceleration components and supplies zero complimentary public IPv4 addresses at deployment.

With its high memory density per compute core, the configuration offers resource efficiency for workloads bottlenecked by RAM rather than CPU execution cycles. Tradeoffs include modest network throughput and complete reliance on external block devices for disk operations. Appropriate deployment scenarios include in-memory caching systems, lightweight transaction databases, memory-backed queuing brokers, and intermediate ETL staging workers.
